body: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has shown strong effectiveness for text-based LLMs and LLM systems, but its application to audio-visual understanding systems requires suitable textual interfaces through which multimodal reasoning can be exposed to text-based optimizers. We investigate how the design of textual interfaces affects prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning, on the audio-visual question answering task. We compare three interface designs, including a direct inference system consisting of a single omni-modal large language model (OmniLLM), a captioner-reasoner system, and an agentic architecture in which a primary agent orchestrates subagent OmniLLMs. Experiments with Qwen3-Omni and Gemini show that direct prompt optimization provides model-dependent gains; the captioner-reasoner system and the agentic system expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize, where error analysis of cases affected by optimization is conducted. Our study highlights textual interface design as an important factor in making prompt optimization effective for omni-modal reasoning systems. Our implementation details are specified in GitHub repo.
summaryZh: 本文研究了自动提示词优化（APO）在多模态推理任务中的应用，重点探讨了文本接口设计对优化效果的影响。研究对比了直接推理系统、标注器-推理器系统以及多智能体架构，发现虽然智能体架构提供了更好的可解释性，但优化难度更高。实验表明，文本接口设计是决定多模态推理系统提示词优化效果的关键因素，为提升Qwen3-Omni和Gemini等模型的推理性能提供了实践指导。

glossary.explanationZh: 自动提示词优化，指通过算法自动调整提示词以提升模型性能的技术。
全模态大语言模型，指能够同时处理文本、音频、图像等多种模态数据的模型。
智能体架构，指通过多个智能体协作完成复杂任务的系统设计。
多模态推理，指模型基于多种输入模态进行逻辑推导和决策的能力。
